newsitem.title: UK: UK constituency backs MP accused of homosexual affair.
newsitem.headline: UK constituency backs MP accused of homosexual affair.

text.p: Conservative member of parliament Jerry Hayes, who is accused of having a 16-month affair with a male teenage researcher in the House of Commons, received a unanimous vote of confidence from his constituency on Tuesday.

"The Executive Council have given their unanimous support to Jerry and his family at this difficult time," said Dave Roberts, chairman of the executive council of Harlow Conservative Constituency Association.
"We have reaffirmed Jerry's position tonight as our candidate in the next election."
Hayes, a 43-year-old father, has denied the allegations which were printed in the News of the World newspaper claiming he had an affair with 18-year-old Paul Stone.
Hayes' lawyers have said he will sue the newspaper for libel.
The allegations were a further embarrassment for Prime Minister John Major, who must call an election by May, and has placed family values at the centre of his re-election campaign.
